context: A boss mentors a uni intern
purpose: Teach: 代物/承っ/施さ/組み立てる/忘れ物/目指せ/習う/参観

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、業界の代物、見極める目、養え。
lines.en: Ren — develop the eye to discern quality in this industry.
lines.style: Measured, direct. Slight pause before the main verb, letting the weight settle. Not unkind, but unadorned. The tone of someone who knows what matters.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。注文を承って対応する流れ、丁寧に学びたいです。
lines.en: Yes. I want to learn the order process carefully, step by step.
lines.style: Deferential but genuine. A small intake before speaking, showing he's listening actively. Quiet conviction underneath. Not performing eagerness, but present with it.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 特殊な工程を施さない製品は、付加価値、出ない。
lines.en: Products without special processing don't add value. Remember that.
lines.style: Teaching tone, not explaining. Slight emphasis on the logic itself — not the words, but the principle. Brief, letting silence do the work after.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: プロジェクトを組み立てる手法、勉強します。
lines.en: I'll study how to structure projects properly.
lines.style: Quick, crisp agreement. Lean forward slightly in the voice — not rushing, but focused. The sound of someone taking mental notes while listening.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 打合せ、忘れ物のないように。
lines.en: Come to meetings prepared. No oversights.
lines.style: Clipped, expectant. Not harsh, but final. A baseline standard, stated plainly. The pause after carries more weight than the words.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 目指せる先輩、見つけました。
lines.en: I found a senior I can actually look up to.
lines.style: Soft brightness underneath careful respect. Small smile in the voice without losing composure. The relief of recognizing something real in what seemed formal.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 業界の慣習、習う姿勢、忘れるな。
lines.en: Don't forget — learn the customs of this industry the way you learn anything worth learning.
lines.style: Not quite stern, but weighted. Slow, deliberate pacing on the key phrase. The voice of someone investing in a younger person's future, not just filling time.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 今度、生産ライン、参観、楽しみです。
lines.en: I'm really looking forward to observing the production line.
lines.style: Earnest close — quiet excitement held in check by respect. Small pause before the final word, landing it with genuine interest. A moment of authentic hope.
